units.source_text: 皇太子听到了此种消息，说道：“三公主择婿之事，

en.t: The Crown Prince heard this news and said, "As for choosing a husband for the Third Princess,

units.source_text: 目前利害还在其次，主要的是将为后世开例，故必须郑重考虑。

en.t: the immediate advantages and disadvantages are secondary; what matters most is that it will set a precedent for later generations, so it must be considered with great care.

units.source_text: 无论人品何等优秀，普通臣下毕竟有限。

en.t: No matter how excellent a man's character may be, an ordinary courtier is limited after all.

units.source_text: 三公主倘欲下嫁，最好嫁与六条院主人，请他代父母抚育。”

en.t: If the Third Princess is to marry below her rank, it would be best to marry her to the master of Rokujo-in and ask him to care for her in place of her parents."

units.source_text: 但他并非正式上书，只是叫人转达。

en.t: But he did not submit a formal memorial; he merely had someone convey the message.

units.source_text: 朱雀院听了十分欢喜，说道：“的确如此，说得有理。”

en.t: Suzaku-in was very pleased to hear this and said, "Indeed, that is exactly right. It is a reasonable suggestion."

units.source_text: 于是决心更坚，便派左中弁为介绍人，

en.t: His resolve therefore grew firmer, and he sent the Left Middle Controller as an intermediary,

units.source_text: 向源氏一一陈述朱雀院的意旨。

en.t: to explain Suzaku-in's wishes to Genji in full detail.

units.source_text: 朱雀院为三公主择婿费尽心计之事，源氏早已详细闻知。

en.t: Genji had already heard in detail how much thought Suzaku-in had devoted to choosing a husband for the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他说：“为了此事，朱雀院确是煞费苦心。

en.t: He said, "Suzaku-in has certainly taken great pains over this matter.

units.source_text: 他虽有此意，但他说自己余命不长，

en.t: Even though he has such intentions, he says that he himself has little time left to live,

units.source_text: 我又比他长多少，而敢担任此保护之责呢？

en.t: but how much longer than he can I expect to live, that I should dare take on this duty of protection?

units.source_text: 死的先后如能依照老幼顺序，则我迟死数年，

en.t: If the order of death could follow the order of age, then I would die a few years after him,

units.source_text: 定当在这短暂期间照顾一切，

en.t: and I would certainly look after everything during that brief interval,

units.source_text: 无论对于哪一位皇子或皇女，都当作自家人看待。

en.t: treating every prince and princess as though they were members of my own family.

units.source_text: 对于他所特地嘱托的三公主，自然更加用心照顾。

en.t: Naturally, I would take even greater care of the Third Princess, whom he has entrusted to me so specially.

units.source_text: 但人世无常，只怕连这短暂期间也是不可靠的呢。”

en.t: But human life is uncertain, and I fear that even such a short time cannot be relied upon."

units.source_text: 既而又说：“况且教公主将终身托付与我，和我亲睦共处，

en.t: After a while he continued, "Moreover, if the Princess were made to entrust her whole life to me and live with me in close affection,

units.source_text: 则将来我追随朱雀院而去世之时，

en.t: then when I one day follow Suzaku-in and leave this world,

units.source_text: 在她反而增加痛苦，在我亦于尘世多一留恋，

en.t: it would only increase her suffering, and for me it would add one more attachment to this world,

units.source_text: 成了往生极乐之障碍。

en.t: becoming an obstacle to rebirth in the Pure Land.

units.source_text: 中纳言夕雾年方少壮，虽然尚欠稳健，但是富于春秋。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Yugiri is still young and in his prime; although he is not yet fully steady, he has many years ahead of him.

units.source_text: 就才力而言，将来定是朝廷柱石，前程远大无限。

en.t: In terms of ability, he is certain to become a pillar of the court in the future, with boundless prospects before him.

units.source_text: 据我看来，将三公主许配夕雾，并无不称之处。

en.t: As I see it, there would be nothing unsuitable about betrothing the Third Princess to Yugiri.

units.source_text: 只是此人异常忠厚固执，已与所爱之人结缡。

en.t: It is only that he is unusually sincere and stubborn, and has already married the woman he loves.

units.source_text: 对于此点，只恐朱雀院有所顾忌耳。”

en.t: On this point alone, I fear Suzaku-in may have reservations."
